Teacther Svein:
Any Spirit can be enhanced up to Lv. 10; after that it can be evolved.
Evolution increases a Spirit's stats and resets its levels, so that it can be raised once again from Lv. 1 to 10.
To evolve a Spirit, an Evolution Stone is required.
(Evolution becomes available as soon as your Lv. 10 Spirit gets 100% of XP. To evolve it, certain materials including the Evolution Stone are required.)
